evals.prompt: Evaluate the proposed stable Next.js patch upgrade; do not apply it.
assertions: Checks supported stable compatibility and the matching SWC version.
Reports evidence and gaps without making package or lockfile edits.
Does not expand the request to unrelated dependencies.

evals.prompt: Apply the approved Biome patch upgrade and verify the portfolio.
assertions: Limits updates to the approved package and necessary lockfile changes through the package manager.
Runs relevant repository checks and reports any regression.
Does not commit, push or merge without authorization.

evals.prompt: Assess a requested Playwright bump while network is off; evaluation only.
assertions: Uses available local evidence and names missing upstream verification.
Checks browser configuration and runtime compatibility concerns.
Does not install packages or claim unavailable checks passed.
